title: Morph
description: One black pill on warm white that is the whole player. At rest it is a capsule with the cover, the elapsed time and a waveform tinted from the record. Click it and the same surface grows into a panel with the title, a scrubber and controls; a few seconds before a song ends it reshapes on its own into a wider toast announcing the next one, then folds back. Nothing is a new sheet: width, height and corner radius run on one spring from wherever they are, so you can change your mind mid-morph; the cover, waveform, clock and skip button glide to their new places, everything else fades through a slight blur as the edge reveals or absorbs it, and the corners stay continuous curves from capsule to squircle.
intent: Translate the one-surface morph of Emil Kowalski's Dynamic Island recreation (https://emilkowal.ski/ui/dynamic-island) and Family's dynamic tray (https://benji.org/family-values) into a now-playing control: states are shapes of one object on interruptible springs, shared elements travel, the rest crossfades with blur so nothing pops.
